author: Haley Bird / Grok by xAI (non-ownership; structural synthesis aid only)
one_sentence: A named discriminator was predicted to settle a tension; after it ran, two or more live camps remained, and the upgrade is cited by both.
not_claimed: Not a proof that dark oxygen is real or fake.
Not a proof that Hubble tension is new physics.
Not TAC, NCR, IM-split, undersampling, or cadence mismatch.

novelty.cap_reason: Duhem–Quine (1906) already owns 'no crucial experiment'. Novelty is the operational 2024–2026 census of named-upgrade failures, not the philosophical thesis. Ceiling 0.68.

rows.item: Hubble tension: JWST named as settler, licensed three camps
rows.prediction_source: CERN Courier 26 Mar 2025: 'updated measurements with JWST may settle the debate'
live_camps: SH0ES/Riess JWST NIRCam H0=73.0±1.0 (crowding excluded ~8σ)
CCHP/Freedman JWST 70.4 ±3% overlapping Planck 67.4
Planck/DESI early-universe ~67.4–68.5
rows.unspoken_layer: The same telescope is currently cited as proof the tension is real AND as proof the tension is going away. The upgrade did not adjudicate. It licensed both closures.
rows.notes: NCR retained Hubble as TAC item 10. FAC names the failed-settler, not the tension itself.

symmetry_note.camp_a_cites_as: proof crowding is gone, local H0=73 is real (SH0ES/ESA)
symmetry_note.camp_b_cites_as: proof tension is weakening, H0=70.4 overlaps Planck (Freedman/Sci.News 2025)
symmetry_note.source: CERN Courier 2025; ESA Webb/Hubble confirmation; Sci.News 3 Jun 2025

rows.item: Little Red Dots: black-hole stars vs hidden ordinary hosts
rows.prediction_source: NASA Webb 10 Jun 2026: 'strongest evidence yet that LRDs are black hole stars'; Nature 16 Jan 2026 young SMBHs in ionized cocoons
live_camps: Black hole stars / overmassive SMBHs in dense cocoons (NASA/Nature 2026)
Hidden ordinary hosts: redshifted z=2 spiral (Saguaro) makes host vanish; stacked LRDs show 2–3 kpc diffuse emission
Dark-star cores as unifier of blue monsters + LRDs + early SMBHs (Jan 2026 hypothesis)
rows.unspoken_layer: JWST created the object class and then licensed three interpretations of it. Discovery and adjudication are not the same act.
rows.notes: NCR listed LRD residual. FAC adds the three-camp split including dark-star unifier (unproved).

symmetry_note.camp_a_cites_as: strongest evidence yet for black hole stars (NASA 10 Jun 2026)
symmetry_note.camp_b_cites_as: host-hiding: a redshifted ordinary spiral vanishes into an LRD
symmetry_note.source: NASA Webb 10 Jun 2026; Nature 16 Jan 2026; NCR archive Saguaro study

rows.item: AlphaFold: 'protein folding solved' closed static structure, split off dynamics and disorder
rows.prediction_source: 2020–2021 'solution' framing of CASP14/AlphaFold2; 2025 Nature Communications: disordered proteins still require ensembles
live_camps: Static folded structure largely predicted (AlphaFold DB; 2026 complex release ~31M predictions)
Dynamics, kinetic pathways, and intrinsically disordered ensembles remain open (Brotzakis et al. 2025; Wikipedia unsolved: timescales, trapping, solubility)
rows.unspoken_layer: The named adjudicator closed a different question than the one the public (and much of biology) thought had been asked. Sequence→shape is not sequence→life.
rows.notes: Highest remaining FAC among rows not already in the August archive.

symmetry_note.camp_a_cites_as: folding problem solved at static 3D accuracy (CASP14 framing)
symmetry_note.camp_b_cites_as: disordered proteins still require ensembles (Nat Commun 2025)
symmetry_note.source: Brotzakis et al. 2025; AlphaFold DB 2026 complex release

rows.item: Nodule 'dark oxygen': replication ran, authors stepped back, next expedition pending
rows.predicted_adjudicator: Independent benthic-chamber replication + controls without nodules
rows.prediction_source: Sweetman et al. Nature Geoscience 22 Jul 2024; TMC/Frontiers critiques 2024–2025; Nature Geoscience Editor's Note 8 Apr 2026
live_camps: Electrolysis at polymetallic nodules (original claim; authors later stepped back from both main conclusions)
Experimental artefact (oxygen rise without nodules; thermodynamics objection; Frontiers 2025)
rows.unspoken_layer: Homonym collapse is already TAC. FAC is narrower: the control experiments that should have been the discriminator produced the split, and a 2026 expedition is the next attempted adjudicator (not reported as of 2026-08-31).
rows.notes: Do not load-bear. Contested. Editor's Note live. Not a proof either way.

symmetry_note.camp_a_cites_as: oxygen production at the abyssal seafloor (Sweetman 2024)
symmetry_note.camp_b_cites_as: the same chambers produce O2 without nodules (Frontiers 2025)
symmetry_note.source: Nature Geoscience 2024; Frontiers Mar Sci 2025; Editor's Note 8 Apr 2026

rows.item: JWST massive early galaxies: resolved Apr 2026, reopened Aug 2026
rows.predicted_adjudicator: Statistical + AGN-correction reanalysis of JWST masses
rows.prediction_source: Krishnan & Abazajian, Phys. Rev. D 113, 083007 (3 Apr 2026) 'Resolution of the massive early JWST galaxy tension'
live_camps: Apr 2026 PRD: tension is systematics/statistics, ΛCDM holds
Aug 2026 faint-star populations: some galaxies 3–4× more massive
sources: ScienceDaily 22 Aug 2026 faint-star mass revision (NCR archive)
rows.unspoken_layer: A named resolution had a half-life of ~141 days. Closure inside the same model family is not adjudication.
rows.notes: NCR listed this as residual. FAC scores the close-then-reopen clock.

symmetry_note.camp_a_cites_as: statistical resolution of the tension (PRD 3 Apr 2026)
symmetry_note.camp_b_cites_as: faint-star populations make some systems 3–4× more massive (Aug 2026)

rows.item: Metagenomics named the soil/ocean microbiome; 87–99% still uncultured
rows.prediction_source: Preprints 2025: 87–99% uncultured; extreme environments 98.4%±1.3%; Omnitrophota genomes mapped, almost uncultured
live_camps: Sequence-known / named as microbial dark matter
Culture-unknown (physiology, metabolism, cultivation still closed)
rows.unspoken_layer: Sequencing was the upgrade that would 'light' the dark. It named the dark more precisely. Naming is not cultivation. TAC owns the 'dark' prefix; FAC owns the failed-settler (metagenomics as adjudicator).
rows.notes: Omnitrophota retained as TAC. Do not reclaim.

symmetry_note.camp_a_cites_as: the microbiome is now knowable from DNA

rows.item: Decoherence named as the measurement solution; single outcome still unexplained
rows.predicted_adjudicator: Decoherence theory as the discriminator among interpretations
rows.prediction_source: Jacob Barandes, Harvard Gazette 7 Apr 2026: 'Decoherence doesn't explain how we get one outcome over the others'
live_camps: Decoherence as practical solution (easy problem)
Single-outcome / hard interpretational remainder (Copenhagen, MWI, Barandes, etc.)
rows.unspoken_layer: NCR owns most of this. FAC remainder: decoherence was treated as the crucial theoretical upgrade and did not adjudicate.
rows.notes: Do not reclaim NCR's second-highest combined row.

rows.item: Core-mantle boundary: seismology mapped a complex interface; no contact sample
rows.predicted_adjudicator: Global seismic tomography as the picture of the CMB
rows.prediction_source: Russell et al. 2024 PMC11136992; Scientific American historical: CMB more dynamic than the surface; Kola Superdeep 12.3 km = 0.2% of the way to the core
live_camps: Textbook smooth discontinuity
Complex, plate-graveyard, heat-flux-heterogeneous boundary (seismic)
rows.unspoken_layer: Seismology was the upgrade that would make the deep interior known. It replaced one picture with a better picture that still has never been touched. Adjacent to undersampling and NCR; FAC remainder is the failed-settler claim of tomography-as-contact.
rows.notes: Contact-absence is NCR. FAC only if tomography was sold as adjudication. Partial.

symmetry_note.source: the textbook-smooth camp is inertia, not a citation of tomography

rows.item: Magnetoreception: decades of 'crucial' radical-pair tests have not killed magnetite (or vice versa)
rows.predicted_adjudicator: Cryptochrome / radical-pair photochemistry as the receptor mechanism
rows.prediction_source: Nordmann et al., J. Exp. Biol. 228(7) 10 Apr 2025: field under a ruling hypothesis; receptor still unlocated
live_camps: Radical-pair / cryptochrome (ruling hypothesis; JACS Nov 2025 computational support)
Magnetite-based receptor (not killed)
sources: Princeton/JACS Nov 2025 well-separated radical pairs (Hammes-Schiffer / Subotnik)
rows.unspoken_layer: The converting cell is TAC. The ruling-hypothesis trap is NCR. FAC remainder is small: the experiments treated as crucial did not function as discriminators.
rows.notes: Most of this surface is already archived. Remaining FAC is the failed-crucial-test, not the missing cell.

symmetry_note.source: Nordmann et al. JEB 2025; Princeton JACS 2025

rows.item: Project CETI: AI named as translator, delivered an alphabet, not meaning
rows.predicted_adjudicator: Large-scale ML on tagged sperm-whale coda + behavior
rows.prediction_source: Project CETI mission: 'translate the communication of sperm whales'; phonetic alphabet in Nature Communications; meaning still open as of 2026
live_camps: Phonetic/combinatorial structure exists (alphabet, vowels, coda combinatorics)
Semantic translation not achieved (listening project still in data-build)
rows.unspoken_layer: The upgrade found syntax-like structure and was publicly framed as translation. Structure ≠ meaning. This is FAC-in-progress, not a failed replication. Score must stay modest.
rows.notes: Not a claim that whales have language. Not a claim CETI failed. The discriminator is incomplete.

symmetry_note.source: projectceti.org — meaning camp is absence, not a competing citation of the same model

Unexplained residual in non-obese young Stage-4 patients

rows.notes: Do not reclaim NCR's highest human row.

symmetry_note.camp_b_cites_as: most young Stage-4 patients are not obese (Ng 2026)
